results.idea: Cross-sectional dividend-yield divergence: bp12m_yld vs index trailing 12-month yield
results.description: Uses SUGGESTION1 to combine projected 12m yield and index trailing 12m yield. Both fields coverage ~0.51-0.71 so I applied SUGGESTION3: ts_backfill(...,20) to mitigate missingness. I favored anl48_bp12m_yld (high userCount=106, SUGGESTION4 applied) and anl48_index_m21_dly_dvd_yqe (higher coverage) to improve signal stability. Operators kept few (<=7) and two datafields only (KEEP_IN_MIND2). Confidence set to 0.72 because yield divergence historically predicts reversion but can be noisy.

results.idea: Dividend health momentum: current health score change
results.description: Applied SUGGESTION1 by comparing dividend health to recent history. Field anl48_bdvd_curr_dvd_health has moderate coverage (~0.524) so I used ts_backfill(...,30) per SUGGESTION3. Used ts_delta to capture momentum and ts_zscore for cross-sectional normalization. Kept operators small and single datafield (KEEP_IN_MIND2). Confidence 0.66 — health score meaningful but occasionally lagged.

results.idea: Forecast vs actual last dividend: bpda relative surprise
results.description: Combine next forecasted DPS (anl48_bpda) with most recent net dividend (anl48_equity_dvd_sh_last) per SUGGESTION1. Both have coverage ~0.51 so used ts_backfill(...,30) (SUGGESTION3). Compute relative surprise (subtract / divide) and cross-sectionally zscore. Preference for anl48_bpda due to moderate userCount (8) per SUGGESTION4. Confidence 0.68 — forecast errors often translate to price moves.

results.idea: Short-term dividend yield reversal: recent drop then bounce
results.description: Used bp12m_yld trend (anl48_bp12m_yld) and short-term mean (anl48_equity_m21_dly_dvd_yqe) to detect reversals (SUGGESTION1). Because bp12m_yld coverage <0.6, applied ts_backfill(...,15) per SUGGESTION3. Implemented ts_zscore of delta to reduce outliers. Confidence 0.63 — short-term reversions exist but are lower signal.

results.idea: Upcoming ex-date proximity trade
results.description: Exploit price drift into ex-dividend dates using next forecasted ex-date (anl48_bdvd_next_est_ex_dt). Coverage ~0.524 so used ts_backfill(...,60). I pair timing signal with bp12m_yld to size exposure (SUGGESTION1). Kept operators simple per KEEP_IN_MIND2. Confidence 0.60 — calendar effects are real but transaction costs matter.

results.idea: Dividend-health vs forecasted yield divergence
results.description: Compare dividend health (anl48_bdvd_curr_dvd_health) with projected 12m yield (anl48_bp12m_yld) to find mispricing (SUGGESTION1). Applied ts_backfill on both (coverage <0.6). Then cross-sectional zscore. Used high userCount field anl48_bp12m_yld per SUGGESTION4. Confidence 0.70 — combining health and yield increases robustness.

results.idea: Dividend forecast acceleration: change in bpda
results.description: Measure acceleration in next DPS forecast (anl48_bpda) using ts_delta over 63 days. Coverage ~0.513 so applied ts_backfill(...,30). Single-field but SUGGESTION1 partially applied via time aggregation. Kept operators minimal. Confidence 0.62 — forecast acceleration signals fundamentals but can be analyst-driven noise.

results.idea: Index-level dividend surprise: index_ldg vs index trailing yield
results.description: Combine anl48_index_ldg (recent gross dividend) with anl48_index_m21_dly_dvd_yqe to detect index-wide divergence per SUGGESTION1. Coverage of index fields higher (>0.71) so no backfill needed for index_m21 but conservative ts_backfill(...,20) applied to index_ldg. Confidence 0.59 — index moves less actionable but diversifies alpha sources.

results.idea: High dividend-growth stocks: bp3y projected growth ranking
results.description: Use anl48_bp3y_dg (3-year projected DPS growth) to target growthy dividend names. Coverage ~0.484 (low) so applied ts_backfill(...,180) per SUGGESTION3. Then cross-sectional quantile ranking. SUGGESTION4 not used because userCount low; flagged in description. Confidence 0.57 — low coverage reduces confidence.

results.idea: Dividend projection momentum scaled by index size
results.description: Combine projected total dividend points (anl48_bp12m_dip, high coverage 0.829) with count of index members (anl48_count_index_members) to scale signals (SUGGESTION1 & 4). No backfill needed for bp12m_dip. Use ts_zscore for normalization. Confidence 0.68 — index-level aggregate projects persistent effects.

results.idea: Gross dividend history spike detection
results.description: Detect sudden increases in gross dividend history (anl48_bedhga) using ts_max_diff to quantify current vs recent max. Coverage ~0.517 so applied ts_backfill(...,90). Single-field, few operators. Confidence 0.61 — payouts spikes often precede re-rating.

results.idea: Dividend yield mean-reversion scaled by last paid dividend
results.description: Compare projected 12m yield (anl48_bp12m_yld) with last paid net dividend (anl48_equity_dvd_sh_last) to size mean-reversion bets (SUGGESTION1). Both low coverage -> ts_backfill(...,30). Use subtract and zscore. Confidence 0.69 due to combining projection and realized payout.

results.idea: Ex-date historical return reversal
results.description: Exploit average short-term return around ex-date using td_xe_dvd (anl48_td_xe_dvd) paired with trailing dividend yield (anl48_equity_m21_dly_dvd_yqe). Applied ts_backfill(...,90) on td_xe_dvd. Kept operators minimal. Confidence 0.58 — calendar arbitrage but execution-sensitive.

results.idea: Dividend health z-score cross-sectional
results.description: Compute cross-sectional zscore of dividend health (anl48_bdvd_curr_dvd_health) using ts_backfill(...,30) since coverage ~0.524. Simple, uses SUGGESTION3 and keeps to one field (KEEP_IN_MIND2). Confidence 0.64 — health score correlates to stability but not immediate alpha.

results.idea: Relative forecast cut: recent downgrade in bpda vs history
results.description: Detect cuts by comparing current bpda to 6-month moving average (anl48_bpda). Coverage low so used ts_backfill(...,180) and ts_mean(.,126). SUGGESTION1 partially applied via time aggregation. Confidence 0.67 — cuts often lead to negative returns.

results.idea: Large index dividend concentration: bp12m_dip per index member
results.description: Scale index total dividend projection (anl48_bp12m_dip) by number of index members (anl48_count_index_members) to detect concentration (SUGGESTION1). Both have high coverage; no backfill needed. Confidence 0.65 — index concentration can reveal skewed opportunities.

results.idea: Dividend yield acceleration zscore
results.description: Measure acceleration: ts_delta of ts_delta on anl48_bp12m_yld (SUGGESTION1 temporal compound). Coverage <0.6 so used ts_backfill(...,40). Then cross-sectionally zscore. Confidence 0.60 — second derivatives noisier but catch momentum shifts.

results.idea: Dividend health relative to index
results.description: Compare company dividend health (anl48_bdvd_curr_dvd_health) with index m21 yield (anl48_index_m21_dly_dvd_yqe) to find outliers (SUGGESTION1). Both backfilled (coverage<0.6). Then subtract and zscore. Confidence 0.66 — relative weakness can predict underperformance.

results.idea: Dividend forecast dispersion proxy: use bpda vs bp12m_yld
results.description: Use two fields (anl48_bpda and anl48_bp12m_yld) to proxy dispersion between per-share forecasts and yield. Applied ts_backfill on both. Then compute absolute difference and zscore. SUGGESTION4 applied by using bp12m_yld high userCount. Confidence 0.61.

results.idea: Dividend cut early-warning: rapid decline in gross dividend history
results.description: Use ts_arg_min on gross dividend history (anl48_bedhga) over 252 days to detect recent lows (SUGGESTION1 temporal). Field coverage ~0.517 -> ts_backfill(...,252) applied. Confidence 0.63 — large drops precede cuts.

results.idea: High-yield anomaly: large bp12m_yld but low dividend health
results.description: Combine anl48_bp12m_yld and anl48_bdvd_curr_dvd_health (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled both since coverage<0.6. Long low-health-high-yield shorts and vice versa using rank. Confidence 0.71 — classic value+distress trade in dividend space.

results.idea: Recent ex-date clustering: count members with exdates
results.description: Use anl48_bulk_count_index_members (coverage 0.8259) as scaling with ex-date proximity field anl48_td_xe_dvd. Applied ts_backfill on td_xe_dvd. SUGGESTION1 used to combine universe-level and security-level signals. Confidence 0.56 — structural but less granular.

results.idea: Dividend yield vs last announced gross dividend ratio
results.description: Compute ratio between projected 12m yield (anl48_bp12m_yld) and last gross dividend (anl48_equity_ldg) to find stretched yields (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled both. Then zscore cross-sectionally. Confidence 0.67.

results.idea: Rapid increase in dividend projections relative to last paid
results.description: Compare ts_delta of anl48_bpda (forecast) vs anl48_equity_dvd_sh_last to detect sharp upward revision (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled both. Use ts_zscore for normalization. Confidence 0.65.

results.idea: Index dividend yield trend strength
results.description: Use ts_ir (information ratio) on index_m21_dly_dvd_yqe to measure trend quality. Applied directly (coverage >0.71) without backfill. Suggestion1 less relevant; used single strong datafield (SUGGESTION4 not applicable for index). Confidence 0.58.

results.idea: Dividend forecast consistency: count of non-nulls in bpda history
results.description: Use ts_count_nans on anl48_bpda to measure forecast consistency (SUGGESTION1 temporal). Coverage low so ts_backfill(...,180) considered but count_nans handles NaNs. Confidence 0.54 — proxy for analyst attention.

results.idea: Dividend yield divergence vs sector index (proxy using index fields)
results.description: Compare company projected yield (anl48_bp12m_yld) to sector/index m21 yield (anl48_index_m21_dly_dvd_yqe) to detect relative mispricing (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled company field. Confidence 0.68.

results.idea: Dividend forecast vs gross history momentum spread
results.description: Spread between bpda forecast momentum and gross dividend history growth (anl48_bedhga). Both fields backfilled. Use ts_delta and subtract. Confidence 0.62.

results.idea: Large upcoming projected pay-date shifts
results.description: Use anl48_bnepd (next forecasted pay date) ts_arg_min over 90 days to identify recent changes in payment schedule and pair with bp12m_yld to size exposures (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled dates. Confidence 0.55.

results.idea: Dividend yield zscore momentum
results.description: Use ts_zscore of ts_returns of anl48_bp12m_yld to capture momentum in yield changes. Applied ts_backfill given coverage. SUGGESTION2 not applicable (no vector). Confidence 0.61.

results.idea: Dividend payout acceleration vs index
results.description: Compare acceleration in company bpda with index_bp12m_dip to find companies outpacing index trends (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled company bpda; index dip high coverage no backfill. Confidence 0.66.

results.idea: Trailing 12-month dividend yield rank
results.description: Cross-sectional rank (quantile) of anl48_equity_m21_dly_dvd_yqe to target high/low trailing yields. Coverage ~0.513 so ts_backfill(...,30) applied. Simple and widely used (SUGGESTION4 low userCount but field has moderate alphaCount). Confidence 0.64.

results.idea: Dividend forecast surprise vs consensus proxy
results.description: Proxy surprise by comparing current bpda to its 3-month median (ts_arg_min/ts_kth not needed). Backfilled bpda. SUGGESTION1 partially temporal. Confidence 0.63.

results.idea: Dividend history volatility: stddev of gross history
results.description: Measure volatility in gross dividend history using ts_std_dev on anl48_bedhga (SUGGESTION1 temporal). Applied ts_backfill due to coverage. Confidence 0.58.

results.idea: Dividend health divergence from 6-month mean
results.description: Compare current dividend health to 126-day mean (anl48_bdvd_curr_dvd_health). Coverage <0.6 so ts_backfill used. Zscore normalize. Confidence 0.65.

results.idea: Large recent increase in index member dividends
results.description: Detect index-level increases using ts_delta on anl48_index_m21_dly_dvd_yqe. Coverage high so no backfill needed. SUGGESTION1 used index field only; kept operators minimal. Confidence 0.57.

results.idea: Dividend payout stability score: variability in past 12 months
results.description: Compute ts_std_dev of anl48_equity_dvd_sh_last over 252 days (SUGGESTION1 temporal). Applied ts_backfill (coverage ~0.509). Confidence 0.60.

results.idea: Projected yield vs realized trailing yield gap
results.description: Subtract trailing m21 yield (anl48_equity_m21_dly_dvd_yqe) from projected 12m yield (anl48_bp12m_yld) to find mispricing. Both backfilled. Use ts_zscore. Confidence 0.70.

results.idea: Dividend forecast consistency vs last announced
results.description: Compute ratio between bpda and last announced equity dividend (SUGGESTION1). Applied ts_backfill on both fields. Simple ratio then zscore. Confidence 0.64.

results.idea: Dividend cut probability proxy: drop in bpda percentile
results.description: Track decline in bpda quantile via quantile(ts_backfill(bpda,180)) and ts_delta. Coverage low so backfilled (SUGGESTION3). Confidence 0.59.

results.idea: High implied option range vs forecast yield
results.description: Use options implied ranges fields anl48_bc_bdvd_opt_implied_range_high/low where available to detect volatility; coverage ~0.428 so below 0.6 — ts_backfill applied. Pair with bp12m_yld to size trades (SUGGESTION1). Confidence 0.50 — low coverage and userCount absent reduce reliability.

results.idea: Dividend forecast momentum vs last gross dividend
results.description: Compare ts_returns of bpda vs returns of equity_ldg (anl48_equity_ldg) to find acceleration mismatches (SUGGESTION1). Both backfilled. Confidence 0.62.

results.idea: Ex-date liquidity proxy: index member count * proximity
results.description: Multiply anl48_count_index_members by indicator of near ex-date (anl48_td_xe_dvd backfilled) to estimate liquidity pressure (SUGGESTION1). Simple and within operator limits. Confidence 0.53.

results.idea: Dividend history seasonality: argmax month pattern
results.description: Use ts_arg_max on anl48_bedhga over 365-day window to find seasonal peak timing (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled field due to coverage. Confidence 0.55.

results.idea: High dividend yield with improving health filter
results.description: Long high bp12m_yld names that have positive recent delta in dividend health (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled both fields and zscore combined. Confidence 0.73 — combining yield and improving fundamentals is robust.

results.idea: Dividend payout acceleration scaled by equity size proxy (index count)
results.description: Scale company bpda acceleration by index_count (anl48_count_index_members) as a simple size proxy (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled bpda. Confidence 0.57.

results.idea: Dividend history mean reversion
results.description: Compute ts_av_diff of anl48_bedhga to measure deviation from recent mean (SUGGESTION1). Applied ts_backfill due to coverage. Confidence 0.60.

results.idea: Index dividend concentration anomaly: bulk_idivisor scaling
results.description: Use anl48_bulk_idivisor (coverage ~0.438) cautiously — ts_backfill used — combined with anl48_bp12m_dip to detect index divisor-driven distortions (SUGGESTION1). Confidence 0.52 — low userCount and coverage.

results.idea: Dividend forecast breadth: count of forecasts available
results.description: Use bulk field anl48_bulk_bdvd_all_projections_ibs to proxy breadth of analyst coverage and pair with bp12m_yld to prefer well-covered yields (SUGGESTION1). Applied ts_backfill on bulk field (coverage ~0.524). Confidence 0.60.

results.idea: Dividend health outlier shorting
results.description: Cross-sectional bucket of low anl48_bdvd_curr_dvd_health and short those with negative recent bpda revisions (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled both fields. Confidence 0.66 — health outliers often underperform.

results.idea: Dividend projection surprise quantile
results.description: Compute quantile of recent change in anl48_bpda (ts_delta over 63 days) using ts_backfill due to coverage <0.6. SUGGESTION1 temporal used. Confidence 0.62.

results.idea: Trailing yield vs next forecasted pay date interaction
results.description: Multiply short-term proximity to pay date (anl48_bnepd backfilled) with trailing yield (anl48_equity_m21_dly_dvd_yqe) to capitalize on timing flows (SUGGESTION1). Confidence 0.55.

results.idea: Dividend payout persistence: ts_product of recent payouts
results.description: Use ts_product on anl48_equity_dvd_sh_last over 12 months to capture persistence. Applied ts_backfill due to coverage. SUGGESTION1 temporal. Confidence 0.56.

results.idea: Dividend health stability: days_from_last_change
results.description: Use days_from_last_change on anl48_bdvd_curr_dvd_health to favor stable dividend firms. Coverage ~0.524 so backfill applied. Confidence 0.59.

results.idea: Projected yield zscore ranking with winsorization
results.description: Compute zscore of bp12m_yld after winsorize to reduce outliers (SUGGESTION1 & KEEP_IN_MIND2). Applied ts_backfill on bp12m_yld. Confidence 0.68.

results.idea: Dividend forecast vs gross record date mismatch
results.description: Compare bpda forecast to gross dividend record date effects using anl48_bedhgrd and bpda (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled both fields. Confidence 0.54.

results.idea: Dividend yield momentum conditioned on low volatility history
results.description: Long names with rising bp12m_yld (ts_returns) but low ts_std_dev of gross history (anl48_bedhga). Backfilled both. SUGGESTION1 used multi-field. Confidence 0.69.

results.idea: Dividend forecast stability rank
results.description: Rank stocks by consistency of bpda forecasts using ts_count_nans and quantile ranking. ts_backfill used for coverage. Confidence 0.55.

results.idea: Dividend yield gap persistence (mean reversion signal)
results.description: Compute ts_mean of gap between bp12m_yld and equity_m21 over 126 days and take current minus mean for reversion signal. Backfilled both fields. Confidence 0.67.

results.idea: Dividend history kurtosis anomaly
results.description: Compute ts_kurtosis on anl48_bedhga to identify fat-tailed payout histories. Backfilled field due to coverage. Confidence 0.51.

results.idea: Dividend forecast momentum scaled by last dividend size
results.description: Multiply ts_delta(bpda) with inverse of last announced dividend to emphasize small-base increases. Backfilled both fields. SUGGESTION1 used. Confidence 0.60.

results.idea: Projected dividend per share vs gross dividend history spread
results.description: Subtract gross history (anl48_bedhga) from bpda to find optimistic forecasts. Both backfilled. Cross-sectional zscore applied. Confidence 0.63.

results.idea: Index member dividend concentration change
results.description: Track changes in anl48_count_index_members over time (ts_delta) and pair with index dip to find structural index shifts. Fields have high coverage so backfill optional; used ts_backfill for stability. Confidence 0.56.

results.idea: Dividend yield zscore x low forecast variance filter
results.description: Target high bp12m_yld zscores but only if bpda forecast variance (ts_std_dev) is low — use two fields (SUGGESTION1) and backfill as needed. Confidence 0.70.

results.idea: Dividend forecast cross-sectional acceleration ranking
results.description: Rank ts_delta(bpda,63) cross-sectionally with quantile after backfill. SUGGESTION1 temporal used. Confidence 0.61.

results.idea: Dividend health vs last gross dividend ratio
results.description: Compare anl48_bdvd_curr_dvd_health to anl48_equity_ldg ratio to detect overstated health vs real payouts (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled both. Confidence 0.64.

results.idea: Dividend ex-date crowding: index-level clustering
results.description: Use anl48_index_td_xe_dvd together with anl48_bulk_count_index_members to measure clustering of ex-dates in the index. Both index fields high coverage; minimal operators. Confidence 0.52.

results.idea: Dividend yield spike reversion after ex-date
results.description: Detect a bp12m_yld spike (ts_max_diff) and expect partial reversion post-ex-date; use td_xe_dvd to time trades (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled where needed. Confidence 0.59.

results.idea: Dividend forecast liquidity-adjusted signal
results.description: Scale bpda revisions by inverse of index member count to prioritize more liquid index contexts (SUGGESTION1). Applied backfill to bpda. Confidence 0.58.

results.idea: Dividend history range-driven picks
results.description: Use vec_range if vector field existed; none clearly vector so I skip vec_avg (SUGGESTION2 not applied). Instead use ts_max_diff of anl48_bedhga to find range extremes. Backfill used. Confidence 0.53.

results.idea: Dividend projection vs index gross dividend deviation
results.description: Spread between company bpda and index_ldg to detect company-specific optimism (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled company field. Confidence 0.62.

results.idea: Dividend yield change coherence: ts_corr with equity_ldg
results.description: Compute ts_corr between bp12m_yld and equity_ldg to find names whose yield moves decouple from payouts. Both backfilled; ts_corr used. Confidence 0.60.

results.idea: Dividend forecast versus historical median (surprise)
results.description: Compare current bpda to its 3-year median (kth_element with k=1 after backfill) to detect optimistic surprises. Applied backfill due to coverage. Confidence 0.61.

results.idea: Dividend yield volatility filter for momentum
results.description: Apply momentum on bp12m_yld only when ts_std_dev of equity_dvd_sh_last is below threshold to avoid volatile payout names (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled both. Confidence 0.67.

results.idea: Dividend forecast cross-sectional volatility ranking
results.description: Rank stocks by ts_std_dev(bpda,126) (after backfill) and prefer low-volatility forecasts. SUGGESTION3 applied. Confidence 0.56.

results.idea: Dividend yield mean reversion controlling for index dip
results.description: Compute bp12m_yld zscore and neutralize by index dip (anl48_bp12m_dip) via subtract (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled company field. Confidence 0.65.

results.idea: Dividend health extreme reversal
results.description: Short names with extreme negative dividend-health zscore followed by positive short-term delta in bp12m_yld (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled both fields. Confidence 0.64.

results.idea: Dividend payout seasonality-adjusted signal
results.description: Use ts_arg_max on bdhad/bdhpd style fields would be ideal but using bedhga seasonal peaks (ts_arg_max) to time buys before history-driven peaks. Backfilled bedhga. Confidence 0.54.

results.idea: Low coverage vector fields avoided; robust two-field combos
results.description: Many vector-suggested operators not applicable (no explicit vector fields); followed SUGGESTION1 and SUGGESTION3 to build robust two-field combos using high userCount anl48_bp12m_yld with complementary fields. Kept implementations <=2 fields and <=7 operators. Confidence averaged at 0.66 for combos using bp12m_yld.

results.idea: Dividend forecast vs recent average (short-term)
results.description: Compare bpda to its 3-month mean (ts_mean) after backfill to capture short-term upgrades/downgrades (SUGGESTION1). Confidence 0.61.

results.idea: Ex-date momentum fade
results.description: Fade short-term momentum into ex-date using td_xe_dvd proximity and recent returns of equity dividend yield (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled date field. Confidence 0.55.

results.idea: Dividend forecast dispersion vs index dip
results.description: Measure dispersion between bpda and index dip to find idiosyncratic names (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled bpda. Confidence 0.60.

results.idea: Stable high yield filter
results.description: Select names with high bp12m_yld zscore but low ts_count_nans(bpda) indicating consistent forecasts — backfilled where necessary. SUGGESTION1 used. Confidence 0.71.

results.idea: Dividend payout acceleration vs historical variance
results.description: Measure bpda acceleration (ts_delta) and normalize by its historical ts_std_dev to create a signal (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled bpda. Confidence 0.63.

results.idea: Dividend yield persistence: ts_rank over 90 days
results.description: Use ts_rank on anl48_bp12m_yld over 90 days to find persistent high-yielders. Backfilled due to coverage. Confidence 0.62.

results.idea: Forecast vs last record date deviation
results.description: Compare bpda with bedhgrd (recorded gross history) to surface aggressive forecasts (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled both fields. Confidence 0.58.

results.idea: Low-coverage fields ts_backfill default
results.description: General rule alpha: always apply ts_backfill to fields with coverage <0.6 (SUGGESTION3). I document this as a standard pre-processing step across many dividend fields to improve coverage. Confidence 0.65 as preprocessing improves sample size.

results.idea: Dividend forecast zscore times volatility filter
results.description: Zscore(bpda) but only trade when index m21 volatility low to avoid macro noise. Used anl48_index_m21_dly_dvd_yqe as macro proxy (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled bpda. Confidence 0.59.

results.idea: Dividend history gap to mean reversion
results.description: Subtract current bedhga from its 1-year mean (ts_mean) after backfill to target reversion to mean payouts. SUGGESTION1 temporal applied. Confidence 0.60.

results.idea: Dividend forecast shock detection using ts_zscore
results.description: Flag large bpda changes via ts_zscore(ts_delta(bpda,21)) after ts_backfill. SUGGESTION1 temporal used. Confidence 0.64.

results.idea: Dividend yield vs index lead-lag
results.description: Measure ts_corr between company bp12m_yld and index_m21 over 126 days; low correlation indicates idiosyncratic opportunities (SUGGESTION1). Backfilled company field. Confidence 0.58.
